items.name: Swedish Blind Qualification 2020
items.information:
# This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak
Welcome to this blind focused competition in Stockholm! Everyone is welcome to participate or watch the event, please read through the tabs on this page to gather all the information you need to know. Remember that this competition also partly serves the purpose of being a last chance to qualify for 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD and 3x3x3 Multi-Blind for the Swedish Championship 2020.

-----
# Tävlingen är inställd på grund av utbrottet av COVID-19 i Sverige.
Välkomna till denna blindfokuserade tävling i Stockholm. Alla är välkomna att delta eller besöka tävlingen, men vi rekommenderar att ni läser igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att få all den information som kan vara bra att känna till om tävlingen. Kom också ihåg att denna tävling delvis syftar till att ge en sista chans att kvalificera sig i grenarna 4x4x4 BLD, 5x5x5 BLD och 3x3x3 Multi-Blind till de Svenska Mästerskapen 2020.

items.name: Puget Sound Pajamas 2020
items.information:
# The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.
All competitors are encouraged to attend the competition in their pajamas! All competitors that arrive in their pajamas will be given one raffle ticket. The raffle will take place after 3x3 Round 1.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the "[Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PugetSoundPajamas2020#13775-competitor-responsibilities)" tab.

For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out our [website!](https://www.pnwcubing.com)

items.name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 27 - Mill Valley 2020
items.information: Bay Area Speedcubin' is proud to host our first ever competition in beautiful Marin County! The event is only seven miles north of the Golden Gate Bridge, so come join us! **If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.**
